packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates automatically once required checks pass
Actions are pinned by .github/workflows/actions.lock, so keep readable tags; reusable workflows and images are not in the lockfile and stay digest-pinned, except actions-fyi's
actions-fyi releases its reusable workflows under immutable tags, and the OpenBao and Octo STS trust policies bind some of them to a tag ref, which a commit SHA doesn't match
zizmor-action only installs the zizmor versions it ships a lock for, so update both together
zizmor 1.32.0 can't parse an actions.lock without dependencies: https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2542
Major updates wait for a human
